profiles.finding: Handy United States Bonds diary full OCR and index checked. July24,1863 entry identifies Alfred Campbell Belt as fellow prisoner already in hospital, not newly admitted. Later entries establish continued confinement; no reliable admission or physical release date located. Mock prisoner court in December entry is a recreational episode, not a separate real arrest. No custody dates inferred.

NPS Alcatraz resource study p296 verifies October1873 Alcatraz arrival and May28,1875 death, but prior custody preceded transfer. Death and death-in-custody already stored correctly. No proxy admission used; individual capture remains unresolved.

NPS study p296 confirms February1878 release from Alcatraz and transfer to Fort Leavenworth en route to tribe. Existing February1878 endpoint retained; actual final custody endpoint requires verification. October1873 Alcatraz arrival was transfer after earlier custody, not initial arrest. No date changes.

limitation: Group surrender chronology does not identify exact capture of either individual. 1952 newspaper gives conflicting Captain Jack capture chronology and was not used as exact date evidence. NPS large Modoc War PDF exceeds web fetch size; not claimed read.
